title: Distinguish committed then discarded federation installs in link diagnostics
outcome: Link history distinguishes durable installations deliberately retired after caller cancellation, changed basis or supersession from persistence failures.
acceptance: A committed install discarded after cancellation or supersession has a distinct fixed diagnostic reason, or an explicit documented status meaning, without changing authority/cleanup/transport behavior.
A controlled pending install commits after waiter cancellation and verifies the resulting diagnostic and unchanged cleanup; actual write failures remain distinct.
